task.title: Team invitations
task.body: Admins can invite teammates by email. The invitee gets an email with a link, accepts, and joins the team with the role the admin chose. Invitations expire after 7 days and can be revoked.

subtasks.title: Invitations table and model
subtasks.detail: Migration + model: email, team_id, role, token (unique), expires_at, accepted_at, revoked_at.

subtasks.title: Invitation email template and sender
subtasks.detail: Template with inviter, team name and accept link; a send function with a test using the mail stub.

subtasks.title: POST /teams/:id/invitations
subtasks.detail: Admin-only. Creates an invitation and sends the email. Tests for auth, duplicate invite, bad email.

subtasks.title: POST /invitations/:token/accept
subtasks.detail: Validates token, expiry and revocation, adds the member with the invited role. Tests for every rejection path.

subtasks.title: DELETE /teams/:id/invitations/:invitationId
subtasks.detail: Admin-only revoke. Tests that a revoked token can no longer be accepted.

subtasks.title: Invite modal on the team settings page
subtasks.detail: Email + role picker, calls api-create, shows pending invitations with a revoke button.

subtasks.title: Accept-invitation page
subtasks.detail: Landing page for the email link: signed-out, expired and revoked states.
